lines.zh: 我从浅水里走出来，水到膝
lines.en: I wade out of the shallows, water to my knees.
Muddy water slides off me.
Each step splits the water's surface.
The smell of the mire wraps around me.
I drag my body through the reeds.
The reeds close behind me.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水里碎成几块
lines.en: My shadow breaks into pieces on the water.
I follow the other two.
The bottom mud churns up.
I quicken two steps; the spray flies high.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在水面上起泡
lines.en: My breath bubbles on the water.
I tread the soft mud under the water.

lines.zh: 我从一丛芦苇中间穿过去
lines.en: I push through a stand of reeds.

lines.zh: 我的脚把水底的泥翻起来
lines.en: My feet turn up the bottom mud.
I stand in the water, motionless.

lines.zh: 水面上只露出我的一半
lines.en: Only half of me shows above water.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸把水面推出圈
lines.en: My breath pushes rings across the water.
The other two are nearby.

lines.zh: 我把头慢慢沉下去一点
lines.en: I lower my head slowly into the water.

lines.zh: 一只虫落在水面上，我盯着
lines.en: A bug lands on the water; I watch it.
The mire is quiet but for water.
Weeds hang in my coat.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，水从指缝漏
lines.en: I raise a hand and water leaks between the fingers.
Muddy water washes over my back.

lines.zh: 淹没的泥沼里，我们一群群来
lines.en: In the drowned mire we come in groups
You stand on the bank; I am here.
In this mire, we go for anyone we see.
I edge slowly toward the bank.
The ground under you is soft.

lines.zh: 水正在往下退，你的退路没了
lines.en: The water is dropping; your path is closing.

lines.zh: 我身边的另外两只也动了
lines.en: The other two move as well.
If you back into the mud, it is simple.
Water drips off me.
I watch you half-submerged.
The water ripples, my wound burns.
I cover where I was struck.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变粗，水面起波
lines.en: My breathing roughens and the surface ripples.
I lower my head and the water covers my shoulders.
The other two draw closer.

lines.zh: 我沉下去一点，又浮上来
lines.en: I sink a little, then rise.
I hold the reeds to steady myself.
The water muddies further.
I growl, low.
My breath pushes the surface apart.
Only my eyes show above the water.

lines.zh: 我在这片水里不太吃东西
lines.en: I do not eat much in this water.
Still, the smell is fresh.
Hold your hand lower.
I edge over, unhurried.
Set it on the mud, not in the water.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，手上还在滴水
lines.en: I reach out, water dripping from my hand.
I sniff, then look up at you.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，水响了
lines.en: I shift a step and the water speaks.

lines.zh: 这东西太小了，我看了会儿
lines.en: It is so small; I study it a while.
You hit me and end up wet.
I turn and the spray goes up.
My shoulders are wide; you cannot pass.
We both sink into the mud.
My arm sweeps across you.
Muddy water splashes your leggings.
Your impact throws water over me.

lines.zh: 我的手臂一摆，你就退了
lines.en: One sweep of my arm and you back off.
Our legs meet under the water.
The mud squelches under us.
I push you against the reeds.

lines.zh: 水里看不清，我靠感觉撞
lines.en: The water blinds me; I strike by feel.

lines.zh: 她半身在水里，半身在岸上
lines.en: She is half in water, half out.
We lean together at the reeds.
There are weeds in her coat too.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，望着同一片水
lines.en: We say nothing, watching the same water.

lines.zh: 她伸手拂掉我背上的东西
lines.en: She brushes something off my back.

lines.zh: 她把手搭在我的臂上，很轻。
lines.en: She lays her hand on my arm, lightly.

lines.zh: 我们一起往深处走了一点
lines.en: We wade a little deeper together.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸在水面上成雾
lines.en: Her breath fogs above the water.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，水在中间流
lines.en: We stand abreast, water flowing between.
She answers me, low.
I bend and the water reaches my waist.

lines.zh: 我从泥里摸出一样东西
lines.en: I feel something out of the mud.

lines.zh: 它在水里看着不像东西
lines.en: In the water it does not look like anything.
I lift it before my face.
Water drips off it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进身上挂着的地方
lines.en: I tuck it where it hangs on me.
I feel around in the water a long while.
I pull it out of the mud.
Mud slides off it.
I hold it up; water drips down.
I stop in the water and lift my head.
The other two stop as well.
I lean slowly toward you.
You are already on soft mud.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽没有干的地方
lines.en: There is no dry ground in this mire.
My head turns slowly to you.

lines.zh: 水里传来另外两只的动静
lines.en: The other two stir in the water.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，水没到胸口
lines.en: I sink until the water reaches my chest.
The mud under you begins to give.
My breathing deepens.

lines.zh: 我往你的方向偏了半步
lines.en: I lean half a step your way.
The reeds hide half of me.
I am in no hurry; this mud holds.
The ripples move toward you.
The ground you stand on grows softer.
I raise a hand out of the water.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，水在响
lines.en: I close in step by step, water sounding.
The ground under you is sinking.
The other two circle from the sides.
I am not fast, but I know this water.
Every step back deepens the mud.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，水响得很慢
lines.en: I walk step by step, the water slow and loud.

lines.zh: 另外两只把你的侧面包了
lines.en: The other two take your flanks.

lines.zh: 你往岸上跑，岸也是软的
lines.en: Run for the bank; it is soft too.
I move along the reeds, hard to see.

lines.zh: 我的脚印在水底，看不见
lines.en: My prints are under water, unseen.
You look back; I stop still.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，只露眼睛
lines.en: I sink until only my eyes show.
Every stir in the water is mine.

lines.zh: 你站的地方只剩一小块干土
lines.en: Only a patch of dry ground is left for you.

lines.zh: 我们三个慢慢把圈收紧
lines.en: The three of us slowly tighten the ring.
I keep silent; a shout would spook you.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和水的声混在一起
lines.en: My breathing blends with the water's sound.

lines.zh: 你脚下的泥已经到脚踝
lines.en: The mud is at your ankles now.
I keep coming on one line.
In water I am never in a hurry.
I slap the water's surface.
My hand catches your coat.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，泥水四溅
lines.en: I ram and mud spray goes everywhere.

lines.zh: 我的重量压下来，你站不稳
lines.en: My weight comes down and you cannot stand.

lines.zh: 我的手从水里出来，拍下去
lines.en: My hand comes out of the water and falls.
My slick body knocks you over.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腿往水里带
lines.en: I seize your leg and pull you toward the water.

lines.zh: 我的肩顶得你退了很远
lines.en: My shoulder shoves you far back.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌打在泥上，泥溅你一脸
lines.en: I slap the mud and it splashes your face.
You block, and I wrap my arms around.

lines.zh: 我的重量全压在你的肩上
lines.en: My whole weight bears on your shoulders.

lines.zh: 我抬手一拨，你脚下滑了
lines.en: I sweep a hand and your feet slide.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞你，水声很闷
lines.en: I hit you from the side, the water dull.
You step back and the mud holds you.
The strike misses and the spray goes high.
I push flat against your chest.

lines.zh: 我抓住芦苇，借着它往前扑
lines.en: I grab the reeds to lunge forward.

lines.zh: 我身上的水全甩到你脸上
lines.en: The water on me flies into your face.
You withdraw; I stop and breathe.

lines.zh: 我双手一合，把你夹在中间
lines.en: I clap both hands and catch you between them.
Bubbles rise in the shallows.
My shoulders show first.
Muddy water runs off my back.
I push the reeds apart on both sides.
The other two come up too.
I settle, water only to my waist.
The surface breaks before I show.
The reeds part down the middle.
Muddy water runs off me.

lines.zh: 另外两只在两侧跟着上来
lines.en: The other two rise on either side.
I stop, the water at my waist.
The mire's smell thickens at once.

lines.zh: 水汽一下升起来，我被烫得退了
lines.en: Steam bursts up and the heat drives me back.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩空，整个人陷进泥
lines.en: My foot finds nothing and I sink into mud.

lines.zh: 这片水太深，我的脚够不到底
lines.en: This water is too deep; my feet find no bottom.

lines.zh: 爆风把泥和水一起掀起来
lines.en: The blast throws mud and water up together.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的肩，水从那里进
lines.en: Something pierces my shoulder and water enters.

lines.zh: 那股力量让这片水都不听话了
lines.en: That force turns the water against me.

lines.zh: 水里没什么可吃，我饿得发虚
lines.en: There is little to eat here and I grow hollow.

lines.zh: 雷落在水面上，一路通到我身上
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and runs to me.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我一直往下沉
lines.en: The water is gone; I keep sinking.
